is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus and Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 4, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for GSTe2 L119F, CYP6P9a, and Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west) and N1575Y (page 5, 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts are provided for L119F-GSTe2 in An. funestus (page 8) and L1014F-kdr in An. gambiae (page 8).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from Elendé village and Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 3, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collections and laboratory bioassays.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for Yaoundé and Elendé village, Cameroon (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and experiments conducted in 2019.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of various LLINs against field-collected Anopheles funestus and Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Cameroon. It also assessed the impact of insecticide resistance markers (GSTe2 L119F, CYP6P9a, and kdr mutations) on mosquito longevity post-exposure to LLINs.
